verdict.rationale: Relay's own docs state that users can build and send branded invoices with built-in payment collection from the Invoices section, with no separate tool needed. Its site adds payment requests, flexible payment options, automated follow-up and recurring invoices. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of branding customization and the payment methods accepted, independent or hands-on corroboration of invoicing.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can create and send branded invoices with built-in payment collection

citations.quote: Build and send a branded invoice with built-in payment collection from Invoices — no separate tool needed.
Create invoices, request payments, offer flexible payment options, and let Relay handle the follow-up.
